title: Red Dad Blue Dad 1/1/2021 This Is Deeper Than Crypto And Blockchain 101
author: 360moneymasters Minds
description: I'm a digital assets and blockchain educators. I'm sharing my financial journey providing information towards digit asset and blockchains investments and exposing programming and institutions way of thinking. My model is to explain Red Dad umbrella is information, knowledge, and investing. Blue Dad umbrella is institution, education and spending. So ask yourself which umbrella do you want to place yourself under. My disclosure is I'm not a financial advisor nor investment advisor so anything I say financially or towards investments please don't hold it against me. But I will go down in history
